126.old: The City’s Official Community Plan describes three rural residential designations outside the Urban Area Boundary. Rural Residential lots are generally 0.8 hectares (about 2 acres) where community water is available and 2.0 hectares (about 4.9 acres) where water is on site. Suburban Residential lots are generally 0.4 hectares (about 1 acre), and Estate Suburban Residential lots are also generally 0.4 hectares.
126.new: Outside the Urban Area Boundary, the City’s Official Community Plan sets out three rural residential designations. A Rural Residential lot is typically 0.8 hectares (about 2 acres) with community water available, and 2.0 hectares (about 4.9 acres) if the water is on site. Suburban Residential lots typically run 0.4 hectares (about 1 acre), and so do Estate Suburban Residential lots at 0.4 hectares.

130.new: According to the City, landslides and debris flows are a concern in some parts of Maple Ridge, and warm weather on top of melting snowpacks can trigger landslides.

178.old: The City’s Official Community Plan describes three rural residential designations outside the Urban Area Boundary. Rural Residential lots are generally 0.8 hectares (about 2 acres) where community water is available and 2.0 hectares (about 4.9 acres) where water is on site. 178.new: The Official Community Plan, which is the City’s, names three rural residential designations beyond the Urban Area Boundary. For Rural Residential, the usual lot is 2.0 hectares (about 4.9 acres) on site water, and 0.8 hectares (about 2 acres) once community water is available.
